notes: BUU 2.1.0 - pin to taskbar, sidebar controls, step-to-pool handoff. NEW: on first launch BUU offers to pin itself to the Windows taskbar (asks once). The worker-pool controls (Workers/Batch/Buffer/Auto-scale/Auto/+Job/Run) moved from the top bar into a Worker pool panel in the sidebar. FIXED: stepping through rows manually then switching to the pool now resumes where you left off instead of restarting at row 1. Worker cap raised (ceiling 100->150, ~150MB/worker instead of 600MB) - the real limit is your PestPac licenses, not the machine.
